question_text: Was the morning rush bigger than the evening rush at the main entrance, in terms of how many people came and went?
answer_text: Yes. At MainEntrance, the morning rush was larger: 1252 total people came and went (673 entries, 579 exits) versus 1054 in the evening (561 entries, 493 exits).

citations.cypher:
CALL {
  MATCH (e:Event)-[:DETECTED_BY]->(c:Camera)
  WHERE c.camera_location CONTAINS 'MainEntrance'
    AND e.event_type IN ['person_entry','person_exit']
    AND e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T07:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-08T12:00:00Z'
  RETURN
    coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN e.event_type='person_entry' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS morning_entries,
    coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN e.event_type='person_exit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS morning_exits,
    count(e) AS morning_total
}
CALL {
  MATCH (e:Event)-[:DETECTED_BY]->(c:Camera)
  WHERE c.camera_location CONTAINS 'MainEntrance'
    AND e.event_type IN ['person_entry','person_exit']
    AND e.timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T16:00:00Z' AND e.timestamp_utc < '2025-12-08T21:00:00Z'
  RETURN
    coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN e.event_type='person_entry' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS evening_entries,
    coalesce(sum(CASE WHEN e.event_type='person_exit' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS evening_exits,
    count(e) AS evening_total
}
RETURN
  morning_entries,
  morning_exits,
  morning_total,
  evening_entries,
  evening_exits,
  evening_total,
  (morning_total > evening_total) AS morning_bigger
